content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Panjab University Post Doctoral Fellowship Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Post Doctoral Fellowship. This is a project-based role within Panjab University.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Post Doctoral Fellowship position. This is a project-based opportunity.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is a Walk-in Interview. Candidates are invited to attend the interview directly with their application and required documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application is through a Walk-in Interview. The specific dates for the interview vary by discipline, with the earliest being 27 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Post Doctoral Fellowship?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 1,00,000/- per month on a consolidated basis for the Post Doctoral Fellowship position.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Doctorate degree (Submitted/Awarded) in the relevant subject with published research work to their credit.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the Post Doctoral Fellowship?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST/OBC/Women candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an age relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/Women candidates as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry six hard copies of your application form, educational qualification documents, list of publications, detailed CV, and a 1500-word brief research proposal.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place at Panjab University, Chandigarh. Specific venues will be detailed in the official notification.
